entry.title: setBfree Organ 0.2.1
entry.summary: This rebuild fixes physical Q-Link and automation-screen parameter writes for the current MPC VST wrapper: - ordinary parameter writes no longer request an `UpdateDisplay`; - required display refreshes are rate-limited to one per 50 ms; - `params.lock` now protects the 71 published parameter indexes used by projects, automation and Q-Link maps; - DSP behavior and the four-page Force skin are unchanged from 0.2.0. entry.title: setBfree Organ 0.2.0
entry.summary: setBfree Organ 0.2.0 expands the native Force tonewheel organ into a four-page touchscreen instrument. - UPPER and LOWER/PEDAL pages with colour-coded drawbars and the authentic 16′/8′ pedal pair - ORGAN page with percussion, vibrato/chorus and scanner controls - SETTINGS page with Leslie motor, key-click and leakage controls - 71 automatable parameters with touch, focused Data Wheel, Q-Link, MIDI and project-state support - Readable Force-oriented skin and four hardware screenshots - Portable M

entry.title: setBfree Organ 0.1.12
entry.summary: setBfree Organ 0.1.12 is the catalog-ready MPC/Force release. - Adds a portable installer layout and `mpc-plugin.json` metadata. - Rebuilds the ARMv7 hard-float plugin with a maximum required GLIBC version of 2.29. - Preserves the three-manual drawbar UI, Q-Link/data-wheel control, keyboard split routing, rotary speaker and effects. - Includes the complete corresponding GPL-2.0-or-later source and reproducible build/release instructions in this repository.
